description: Reduced kinetics model used by the 3D coupled solver. Electron rates come from LXCat cross sections (swarm tables generated by rf_plasma.swarm); heavy-particle chemistry entries cite gas_kinetics_literature.json (reference keys) with their verification status. Units SI; Te_K/300 power laws unless noted.

electron_rates.source: IST-Lisbon LXCat cross sections (LoKI-B distribution) -> BOLOS two-term Boltzmann (bulk) and Maxwellian (filament) tables in cases/swarm/

beta_atomic_m3_s.source: radiative recombination neglected (orders below 3-body at these densities)

beta_atomic_neutral_m6_s.source: no verified Ar+ + e + Ar coefficient; omitted

beta_dimer_m3_s.source: Kemaneci2017 Table 3 R27+R28 (sum of two identical channels; secondary of Kabouzi 2007)
beta_dimer_m3_s.note: Sum of the two tabulated channels is an inference.

k3b_m6_s.source: Kemaneci2017 Table 3 R32 (5.0e-39 Te^-4.5) + R33 (8.75e-39, exponent printed -2.25; -4.5 used)
k3b_m6_s.note: R33 exponent conflict unresolved; -4.5 supported indirectly by the Kossyi-type N2+ value (Peters 2019). Sensitivity: kernel results reported with this caveat.

mobility_K0_m2_Vs.source: no verified K0; ambipolar diffusion disabled (tau_D = w^2/D_a ~ 30 us >> simulated window for K0 ~ 1e-4 m^2/Vs order estimate)

eta_fast.source: baseline: excitation/recombination energy assigned to a radiative/metastable sink; no verified fast-heating fraction

ppt.source: atomic Ar: Z=1, outer 3p electron (l=1, m=0) - atomic structure

beta_atomic_neutral_m6_s.source: Saifutdinov2023 Table 2 R22 (e + He+ + He), (Te/Tg) evaluated with Tg = 300 K

beta_dimer_m3_s.source: Deloche et al. 1976 PRA 13, 1140 (doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.13.1140): two-body alpha(He2+) < 5e-16 m3/s at 293 K (upper limit, abstract); (Te/Tg)^-1 scaling kept from Saifutdinov2023 R24
beta_dimer_m3_s.note: Upper limit used (Saifutdinov2023 R24 prints 5e-15 = 10x the measured bound; changed 2026-11-20). See literature/he-rate-data-verification.md.

k3b_m6_s.source: R21/R25 electron-assisted values have ambiguous units in the source; omitted
k3b_m6_s.note: Omission underestimates recombination at Te < 0.1 eV.

mobility_K0_m2_Vs.source: no verified K0; ambipolar diffusion disabled (see Ar)

cr_model.source: see per-entry sources; conversion/pooling/excimer: Schroter et al. 2018 PCCP 20, 24263 doi:10.1039/c8cp02473a (R380, R316-R319, R8, R55); He2*+He2*: Saifutdinov & Timerkaev 2023 Nanomaterials 13, 1966 doi:10.3390/nano13131966 (R19); levels NIST ASD; resonance broadening NIST Atomic Spectroscopy eq. 41 (https://physics.nist.gov/Pubs/AtSpec/node20.html); Holstein 1951 Phys Rev 83, 1159 Lorentz cylinder g = 1.115/sqrt(pi k0 R) (as commonly cited, not re-read)

kc3_m6_s.source: Schroter2018 R380 (Myers & Cunningham 1977); Saifutdinov2023 R13 gives 2.8e-46 at 300 K

kxx_m3_s.source: Saifutdinov2023 R19 (T/300)^0.5, evaluated at 300 K; sources differ by ~2x for pooling

dion_eV.source: He2+ X-state binding energy (literature value, not re-verified); with Schroter R8 threshold gives Ex = Ip - D - 4.28

i2_eV.source: NIST ASD He II ionization energy

excimer_rad_s.source: UNVERIFIED order of magnitude: lumped He2* (mostly long-lived a3Su+, short-lived singlet share); sensitivity parameter

alpha_rec_m6_s.source: UNVERIFIED estimate: Z^3 scaling of e + He+ + He (Saifutdinov2023 R22)

transport_mobility_K0_m2_Vs.source: commonly quoted Ellis et al. 1976 ADNDT 17, 177 low-field K0 (He+ ~10.4, He2+ ~16.7 cm2/Vs); not re-verified (LXCat unavailable); He2+ Langevin limit 18.8 cm2/Vs

optics.source: He (n-1) = 3.50e-5 at 532 nm, 0 C, 1 atm (Mansfield & Peck 1969 JOSA 59, 199 dispersion formula via refractiveindex.info; consistent with alpha = 1.38376 a.u.); n2 order of magnitude (Borzsonyi 2010 / Shelton & Rice 1994 not re-read) - only P/Pcr << 1 is used

dof.source: diatomic: 3 translational + 2 rotational (vibration frozen at 300 K)

beta_atomic_m3_s.source: Peters2019 Table IV R12 (Kossyi): e + N2+ -> N + N

beta_atomic_neutral_m6_s.source: Peters2019 Table IV R14: e + N2+ + N2

beta_dimer_m3_s.source: Peters2019 Table IV R7-R9 total (tuned; literature range 2.6e-13 - 4.6e-12)
beta_dimer_m3_s.note: Tuned value; sensitivity range quoted in source.

k3b_m6_s.source: Peters2019 Table IV R15: 1e-31 (300/Te)^4.5 m^6/s converted to Te in eV

mobility_K0_m2_Vs.source: no verified K0; ambipolar diffusion disabled

eta_fast.source: baseline: vibrational/electronic energy stored (V-T relaxation slow in pure N2); Popov fraction not verified

dimer_dissociation.source: Peters2019 Table IV R27: N4+ + N2 -> N2+ + 2N2, 2.1e-16 exp(Tg/121) cm^3/s

ppt.source: Talebpour et al. 1999 effective-atom Z_eff = 0.9 as commonly used; NOT confirmed from an opened source

references_extra.Peters2019: Peters C.J., Shneider M.N., Miles R.B., J. Appl. Phys. 125, 243301 (2019), doi:10.1063/1.5098306 (PMC8378216)
